1.english_reference: Amaziah [ was ] twenty and five years old [ when ] he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ
traditions.LXX: Ὢν πέντε καὶ εἴκοσι ἐτῶν ἐβασίλευσεν Ἀμασείας ,
traditions.VUL: Vigínti quinque annórum erat Amasías cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Amaziah [ was ] twenty and five years old [ when ] he began to reign ,

1.english_reference: and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָ תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴκοσι ἐννέα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et vigínti novem annis regnávit in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem .

1.english_reference: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Jehoaddan of Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ יְהוֹעַדָּ֖ן מִ ירוּשָׁלָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Ἰωναὰ ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: nomen matris eius Ióadan de Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Fecítque bonum in conspéctu Dómini :
traditions.KJV: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD ,

2.english_reference: but not with a perfect heart

traditions.WLC: רַ֕ק לֹ֖א בְּ לֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ ἐν καρδίᾳ πλήρει .
traditions.VUL: verúmtamen non in corde perfécto .
traditions.KJV: but not with a perfect heart .

3.english_reference: Now it came to pass , when the kingdom was established to him

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֕י כַּ אֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַ מַּמְלָכָ֖ה עָלָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς κατέστη ἡ βασιλεία ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque roborátum sibi vidéret impérium ,
traditions.KJV: Now it came to pass , when the kingdom was established to him ,

3.english_reference: that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father

traditions.WLC: ו וַֽ יַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת עֲבָדָ֔י ו הַ מַּכִּ֖ים אֶת הַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθανάτωσεν τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ τοὺς φονεύσαντας τὸν βασιλέα πατέρα αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: iugulávit servos , qui occíderant regem patrem suum ,
traditions.KJV: that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father .

4.english_reference: But he slew not their children

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בְּנֵי הֶ֖ם לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν οὐκ ἀπέκτεινεν ,
traditions.VUL: sed fílios eórum non interfécit ,
traditions.KJV: But he slew not their children ,

4.english_reference: but [ did ] as [ it is ] written in the law in the book of Moses

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י כַ כָּת֣וּב בַּ תּוֹרָ֡ה בְּ סֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁה֩
traditions.LXX: κατὰ τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ νόμου Κυρίου καθὼς γέγραπται ,
traditions.VUL: sicut scriptum est in Libro legis Móysi ,
traditions.KJV: but [ did ] as [ it is ] written in the law in the book of Moses ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵ אמֹ֗ר
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐνετείλατο Κύριος λέγων
traditions.VUL: ubi præcépit Dóminus , dicens :
traditions.KJV: where the LORD commanded , saying ,

4.english_reference: The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers

traditions.WLC: לֹא יָמ֨וּתוּ אָב֤וֹת עַל בָּנִים֙ וּ בָנִים֙ לֹא יָמ֣וּתוּ עַל אָב֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: Οὐκ ἀποθανοῦνται πατέρες ὑπὲρ τέκνων , καὶ υἱοὶ οὐκ ἀποθανοῦνται ὑπὲρ πατέρων ,
traditions.VUL: Non occidéntur patres pro fíliis , neque fílii pro pátribus suis ,
traditions.KJV: The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers ,

4.english_reference: but every man shall die for his own sin

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בְּ חֶטְא֖ וֹ יָמֽוּתוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἢ ἕκαστος τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἀποθανοῦνται .
traditions.VUL: sed unusquísque in suo peccáto moriétur .
traditions.KJV: but every man shall die for his own sin .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְבֹּ֤ץ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ συνήγαγεν Ἀμασείας τὸν οἶκον Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: Congregávit ígitur Amasías Iudam ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together ,

5.english_reference: and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of [ their ] fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעֲמִידֵ֣ ם לְ בֵית אָב֗וֹת לְ שָׂרֵ֤י הָ אֲלָפִים֙ וּ לְ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ מֵּא֔וֹת לְ כָל יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ בִנְיָמִ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστησεν αὐτοὺς κατ᾽ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν εἰς χιλιάρχους καὶ ἑκατοντάρχους παντὶ Ἰούδᾳ καὶ Ἰερουσαλήμ ·
traditions.VUL: et constítuit eos per famílias , tribunósque et centuriónes in univérso Iuda , et Béniamin :
traditions.KJV: and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of [ their ] fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin :

5.english_reference: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּפְקְדֵ֗ ם לְ מִ בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ מַ֔עְלָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠρίθμησεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ,
traditions.VUL: et recénsuit a vigínti annis supra ,
traditions.KJV: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above ,

5.english_reference: and found them three hundred thousand choice [ men , able ] to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְצָאֵ֗ ם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף בָּחוּר֙ יוֹצֵ֣א צָבָ֔א אֹחֵ֖ז רֹ֥מַח וְ צִנָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὗρεν αὐτοὺς τριακοσίας χιλιάδας , δυνατοὺς ἐξελθεῖν εἰς πόλεμον , κρατοῦντας δόρυ καὶ θυρεόν .
traditions.VUL: invenítque trecénta míllia iúvenum , qui egrederéntur ad pugnam , et tenérent hastam et clýpeum .
traditions.KJV: and found them three hundred thousand choice [ men , able ] to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield .

6.english_reference: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂכֹּ֣ר מִ יִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֥אָה אֶ֛לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל בְּ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר כָּֽסֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμισθώσατο ἀπὸ Ἰσραὴλ ἑκατὸν χιλιάδας , δυνατοὺς ἰσχύι , ἑκατὸν ταλάντων ἀργυρίου .
traditions.VUL: Mercéde quoque condúxit de Israel centum míllia robustórum , centum taléntis argénti .
traditions.KJV: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver .

7.english_reference: But there came a man of God to him , saying

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֣ישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֗ים בָּ֤א אֵלָי ו֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγων
traditions.VUL: Venit autem homo Dei ad illum , et ait :
traditions.KJV: But there came a man of God to him , saying ,

7.english_reference: O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee

traditions.WLC: הַ מֶּ֕לֶךְ אַל יָבֹ֥א עִמְּ ךָ֖ צְבָ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Βασιλεῦ , οὐ πορεύσεται μετὰ σοῦ δύναμις Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: O rex , ne egrediátur tecum exércitus Israel :
traditions.KJV: O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee ;

7.english_reference: for the LORD [ is ] not with Israel , [ to wit , with ] all the children of Ephraim

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν Κύριος μετὰ Ἰσραὴλ πάντων τῶν υἱῶν Ἐφράιμ .
traditions.VUL: non est enim Dóminus cum Israel , et cunctis fíliis Ephraim :
traditions.KJV: for the LORD [ is ] not with Israel , [ to wit , with ] all the children of Ephraim .

8.english_reference: But if thou wilt go , do [ it ] , be strong for the battle

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י אִם בֹּ֣א אַתָּ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה חֲזַ֣ק לַ מִּלְחָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐὰν ὑπολάβῃς κατισχῦσαι ἐν τούτοις ,
traditions.VUL: quod si putas in róbore exércitus bella consístere ,
traditions.KJV: But if thou wilt go , do [ it ] , be strong for the battle :

8.english_reference: God shall make thee fall before the enemy

traditions.WLC: יַכְשִֽׁילְ ךָ֤ הָֽ אֱלֹהִים֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֔ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ τροπώσεταί σε Κύριος ἐναντίον τῶν ἐχθρῶν ,
traditions.VUL: superári te fáciet Deus ab hóstibus :
traditions.KJV: God shall make thee fall before the enemy :

8.english_reference: for God hath power to help , and to cast down

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י יֶשׁ כֹּ֛חַ בֵּ אלֹהִ֖ים לַ עְז֥וֹר וּ לְ הַכְשִֽׁיל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐστὶν παρὰ Κυρίου καὶ ἰσχῦσαι καὶ τροπώσασθαι .
traditions.VUL: Dei quippe est et adiuváre , et in fugam convértere .
traditions.KJV: for God hath power to help , and to cast down .

9.english_reference: And Amaziah said to the man of God , But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ לְ אִ֣ישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ מַֽה לַּ עֲשׂוֹת֙ לִ מְאַ֣ת הַ כִּכָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ גְד֣וּד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἀμασίας τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τοῦ θεοῦ Καὶ τί ποιήσω τὰ ἑκατὸν τάλαντα ἃ ἔδωκα τῇ δυνάμει Ἰσραήλ ;
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Amasías ad hóminem Dei : Quid ergo fiet de centum taléntis , quæ dedi milítibus Israel ?
traditions.KJV: And Amaziah said to the man of God , But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel ?

9.english_reference: And the man of God answered , The LORD is able to give thee much more than this

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵ֚שׁ לַֽ יהוָ֔ה לָ֥ תֶת לְ ךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מִ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ Ἔστιν τῷ κυρίῳ δοῦναί σοι πλεῖστα τούτων .
traditions.VUL: Et respóndit ei homo Dei : Habet Dóminus unde tibi dare possit multo his plura .
traditions.KJV: And the man of God answered , The LORD is able to give thee much more than this .

10.english_reference: Then Amaziah separated them , [ to wit ] , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim , to go home again

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּבְדִּילֵ֣ ם אֲמַצְיָ֗הוּ לְ הַ גְּדוּד֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤א אֵלָי ו֙ מֵֽ אֶפְרַ֔יִם לָ לֶ֖כֶת לִ מְקוֹמָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ διεχώρισεν Ἀμασείας τῇ δυνάμει τῇ ἐλθούσῃ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀπὸ Ἐφράιμ ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Separávit ítaque Amasías exércitum , qui vénerat ad eum ex Ephraim , ut reverterétur in locum suum :
traditions.KJV: Then Amaziah separated them , [ to wit ] , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim , to go home again :

10.english_reference: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֨חַר אַפָּ֤ ם מְאֹד֙ בִּֽ יהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθυμώθησαν σφόδρα ἐπὶ Ἰούδαν ,
traditions.VUL: at illi contra Iudam veheménter iráti ,
traditions.KJV: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah ,

10.english_reference: and they returned home in great anger

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשׁ֥וּבוּ לִ מְקוֹמָ֖ ם בָּ חֳרִי אָֽף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῶν ἐν ὀργῇ θυμοῦ .
traditions.VUL: revérsi sunt in regiónem suam .
traditions.KJV: and they returned home in great anger .

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔ק
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἀμασείας κατίσχυσεν
traditions.VUL: Porro Amasías confidénter
traditions.KJV: And Amaziah strengthened himself ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּנְהַג֙ אֶת עַמּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρέλαβεν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: edúxit pópulum suum ,
traditions.KJV: and led forth his people ,

11.english_reference: and went to the valley of salt

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֖לֶךְ גֵּ֣יא הַמֶּ֑לַח
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν κοιλάδα τῶν ἁλῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et ábiit in vallem Salinárum ,
traditions.KJV: and went to the valley of salt ,

11.english_reference: and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥ךְ אֶת בְּנֵי שֵׂעִ֖יר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐκεῖ τοὺς υἱοὺς Σηεὶρ δέκα χιλιάδας .
traditions.VUL: percussítque fílios Seir decem míllia :
traditions.KJV: and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand .

12.english_reference: And [ other ] ten thousand [ left ] alive did the children of Judah carry away captive

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים חַיִּ֗ים שָׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ δέκα χιλιάδας ἐζώγρησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰούδα ,
traditions.VUL: et ália decem míllia virórum cepérunt fílii Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: And [ other ] ten thousand [ left ] alive did the children of Judah carry away captive ,

12.english_reference: and brought them unto the top of the rock

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבִיא֖וּ ם לְ רֹ֣אשׁ הַ סָּ֑לַע
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔφερον αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τοῦ κρημνοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et adduxérunt ad prærúptum cuiúsdam petræ ,
traditions.KJV: and brought them unto the top of the rock ,

12.english_reference: and cast them down from the top of the rock

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּשְׁלִיכ֛וּ ם מֵֽ רֹאשׁ הַ סֶּ֖לַע
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατεκρήμνιζον αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἄκρου τοῦ κρημνοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: præcipitaverúntque eos de summo in præceps :
traditions.KJV: and cast them down from the top of the rock ,

12.english_reference: that they all were broken in pieces

traditions.WLC: וְ כֻלָּ֥ ם נִבְקָֽעוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες διερρήγνυντο .
traditions.VUL: qui univérsi crepuérunt .
traditions.KJV: that they all were broken in pieces .

13.english_reference: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנֵ֣י הַ גְּד֗וּד אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֤יב אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ υἱοὶ τῆς δυνάμεως οὓς ἀπέστρεψεν Ἀμασείας
traditions.VUL: At ille exércitus , quem remíserat Amasías
traditions.KJV: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back ,

13.english_reference: that they should not go with him to battle

traditions.WLC: מִ לֶּ֤כֶת עִמּ וֹ֙ לַ מִּלְחָמָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ εὑρεθῆναι μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ εἰς πόλεμον ,
traditions.VUL: ne secum iret ad prœ́lium ,
traditions.KJV: that they should not go with him to battle ,

13.english_reference: fell upon the cities of Judah , from Samaria even unto Bethhoron

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּפְשְׁטוּ֙ בְּ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִ שֹּׁמְר֖וֹן וְ עַד בֵּ֣ית חוֹר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέθεντο ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις Ἰούδα ἀπὸ Σαμαρείας ἕως Βαιθωρών ,
traditions.VUL: diffúsus est in civitátibus Iuda , a Samaría usque ad Béthoron ,
traditions.KJV: fell upon the cities of Judah , from Samaria even unto Bethhoron ,

13.english_reference: and smote three thousand of them

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכּ֤וּ מֵ הֶם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν αὐτοῖς τρεῖς χιλιάδας
traditions.VUL: et interféctis tribus míllibus ,
traditions.KJV: and smote three thousand of them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֖זּוּ בִּזָּ֥ה רַבָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐσκύλευσεν σκῦλα πολλά .
traditions.VUL: dirípuit prædam magnam .
